regions.prompt: Create one compact feature about a real lighthouse. Use web search to find a real public-domain lighthouse photograph on Wikimedia Commons: a direct HTTPS PNG or JPEG thumbnail below 256 KiB. Download it using data-desegnos-download. Write two short factual sentences based on a reliable public source. Include the photo credit and source link beside the photo. No sample content, placeholders, editor notes or invented facts. Use data-desegnos-found on searched text and the photo, pointing to their public source pages. Keep the requested card within its area and mark its root with this request's data-desegnos-region UUID.
